name: dealer-ai-skills
description: AI agent skills for franchise and independent car dealers. Diagnostics, AEO, BDC operations, F&I compliance, fixed ops, equity mining, and growth engineering.

plugins.name: dealer-ai-readiness-audit
plugins.description: Run the 75-point Dealer AI Readiness Audit on a franchise or independent car dealership. 17 sections, vendor-neutral, produces a sequenced 30/60/90 day remediation roadmap.

plugins.name: dealer-aeo-audit
plugins.description: Run the Dealer AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Audit on a car dealership website. 30 checks across 10 dimensions covering AI crawler access, llms.txt, schema markup, entity reinforcement, conversational content, third-party citations, reviews, live AI engine spot-checks, and technical foundation. Produces a prioritized fix list to improve citations in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot. AEO and GEO are functionally synonymous; this skill covers both.

plugins.name: dealer-llms-txt-generator
plugins.description: Generate a curated llms.txt file for a car dealership website. Produces a paste-ready file optimized for AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). Improves citation rates in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot. Pairs naturally with the dealer-aeo-audit: that audit finds the gap, this skill closes it.

plugins.name: dealer-site-score
plugins.description: Dealer Site Score, the dealer website grader. 100-point evaluation across 10 dimensions: performance (Core Web Vitals), hosting, crawlability, security, schema, mobile, accessibility, third-party tag bloat, conversion elements, and dealer-specific signals. Produces a letter grade and prioritized fix list. Branded version of the free tool at dealersitescore.com.

plugins.name: dealer-aeo-content-brief
plugins.description: Generate an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) content brief for a car dealership page or post. Outputs a complete, paste-ready brief with target query, page type, title, opening 100 words verbatim, section outline, required Q&A with AI extraction sentences, internal links, external citations, schema spec, image specs, and length/tone guidance. Pairs with dealer-aeo-audit. Includes seven dealer-specific page-type patterns. AEO and GEO are functionally synonymous; this skill covers both.

plugins.name: dealer-call-transcript-classifier
plugins.description: Classify car dealership call transcripts into five categories (Sales / Service / Parts / Finance / Other) with strict honesty rules that never inflate the Sales count. Auto-detects input format (single transcript, batch paste, CallRail or CRM export). For Sales-classified calls, extracts vehicle of interest, lead source, and contact captured.

plugins.name: dealer-equity-mining-campaign-builder
plugins.description: Build a complete equity mining campaign for a car dealership: blueprint (cadence, channels, gates, KPIs) plus messaging templates (SMS, email, ringless voicemail) across the proven 3-channel cadence. Six personas: lease returner, equity-positive trade-up, service-to-sales, OEM-program eligible, upside-down upgrader, dormant reactivation. Compliance guardrails baked in.

plugins.name: dealer-vdp-merchandising-review
plugins.description: Review a sample of Vehicle Detail Pages (VDPs) on a car dealership website for merchandising quality. 10 dimensions covering photos, descriptions, pricing, vehicle data, schema, CTAs, trust signals, cross-sell, mobile UX, and OEM compliance. Brand-aware: applies OEM-specific standards for GM, Ford, Stellantis, Toyota, Honda, Hyundai/Kia, VW/Audi, Subaru. Per-VDP scorecards plus summary and prioritized fix list.

plugins.name: dealer-customer-sentiment-analyzer
plugins.description: Analyze car dealership customer reviews across multiple dimensions: department-level sentiment, top recurring themes with quoted evidence, named-staff mentions, trend analysis, and reviews that warrant a dealer response. Auto-detects input format. Reads the text rather than relying on star ratings. Honest about negatives.

plugins.name: dealer-search-strategy
plugins.description: Generate a comprehensive search strategy document for a car dealership covering SEO (Search Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). Clarifies the difference between SEO, AEO, and GEO. Produces a unified 4-pillar strategy with an integrated 90-day roadmap covering technical foundation, traditional Google ranking, AI engine citation (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot), and cross-channel reputation. Names the specific marketplace skills as execution tools.

plugins.name: dealer-ai-visibility
plugins.description: Monitor what AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Mode) are actually saying about a car dealership. Runs a 25-30 query taxonomy with bilingual variants, extracts citations, buckets cited sources by type (OEM, third-party listings, reviews, forums, local press, dealer-owned), computes citation share against competitors, and produces a quarterly report plus optional Word doc and live HTML dashboard. Branded as Dealer AI Visibility at dealeraivisibility.com. Distinct from dealer-aeo-audit: the audit finds the gaps; this skill measures the live result and competitive share.

plugins.name: dealer-store-positioning
plugins.description: Generate a comprehensive positioning brief and marketing-team-ready content kit for a car dealership. Includes positioning statement, target customer, value proposition, differentiation, voice and tone, brand promise, we-are/we-are-not boundaries, boilerplate language (3 lengths), tagline options, social media bio templates, email signature templates, value proposition variants, and pre-approved language guidelines. Foundational skill: every other marketing skill in the marketplace references the positioning output as input.

plugins.name: dealer-comparison-page-builder
plugins.description: Build one in-depth comparison page between a car dealership and a single named competitor. Optimized for AEO/GEO citation, Google ranking on 'Dealer A vs Dealer B' queries, and sales floor enablement. Includes 10-15 dimension comparison framework, fair-play rules (the competitor wins on at least one dimension for credibility), schema markup spec, and sales floor talk track for when customers are cross-shopping.

plugins.name: dealer-new-customer-onboarding
plugins.description: Design a comprehensive 90-day post-sale customer onboarding program for a car dealership. Multi-channel (email + SMS + in-person + optional ringless voicemail) covering delivery through first service intro. Built around the critical sales-to-service handoff that determines long-term service retention. Includes OEM-specific connected services activation flows (OnStar, FordPass, Uconnect, etc.). 4 phases, 15-20 touchpoints, ready-to-use templates per touchpoint.

plugins.name: dealer-email-flows
plugins.description: Build comprehensive lifecycle email flows for a car dealership covering the full customer relationship from purchase through year 5+. 17 dealer-specific flows including service reminders, declined recovery, lease maturity, equity check-in, anniversary, OEM event invite, lapsed-service revival, recall outreach, birthday, holiday, win-back, referral, test-drive follow-up, quote follow-up, service appointment confirmation, post-service NPS, and delivery welcome. No abandoned-cart pattern. Compliance guardrails inherited from dealer-equity-mining-campaign-builder.

plugins.name: dealer-seo-audit
plugins.description: Comprehensive traditional Google SEO audit for car dealer websites. 10-dimension, 100-point framework covering crawlability, indexation, on-page SEO (titles, metas, headings), keyword targeting and cannibalization, content depth, URL structure, internal linking, local SEO, inventory feed SEO, hreflang for bilingual sites, and E-E-A-T. Dealer-specific overlays for VDP titles and Vehicle schema, aged inventory handling, NAP at scale, and Spanish-language hreflang implementation. Distinct from dealer-aeo-audit (AI engine citation) and dealer-site-score (technical foundation grader).

plugins.name: dealer-cta-audit
plugins.description: Audit calls-to-action on car dealership website pages for conversion effectiveness. Conversion-focused 6-dimension, 100-point framework: visibility, hierarchy, mobile UX (touch targets, click-to-call, sticky CTAs), copy quality, page-type fit, and tracking. Auto-detects scope (single page, sample, full sweep). Per-page CTA inventory plus scorecard, summary headline, per-page detail, and prioritized fix list with specific replacement copy and design recommendations.

plugins.name: dealer-gbp-audit
plugins.description: Audit a car dealership's Google Business Profile (GBP) for local SEO and local pack performance. 10-dimension, 100-point framework covering primary category accuracy, secondary categories, NAP consistency, hours, services list, attributes, photos and visual freshness, posts, Q&A management, and review signal plus response discipline. Single-rooftop default with multi-rooftop dealer-group consistency overlay (additional 25-point scale). Mode A: guided audit with manager access. Mode B: public-search audit for competitor and prospect teardowns.

plugins.name: dealer-bilingual-seo
plugins.description: Build, audit, or remediate a Spanish-language SEO presence for a US car dealership targeting Hispanic buyers. Three modes: audit existing bilingual site (10-dimension, 100-point framework), design from scratch (architecture decision, content prioritization, 90-day roadmap), or remediate broken implementation (diagnostic decision tree, remediation sequence). Covers hreflang for en-US and es-US, subfolder vs subdomain architecture, content tier prioritization, Spanish-language Vehicle/AutoDealer/FAQPage schema, dealer.com/DealerOn/DealerInspire platform specifics, OEM Spanish program integration (GM en Espanol, Ford Espanol, Toyota Espanol), Spanish GBP and review strategy, and US Hispanic auto buyer behavior. Defensible expertise from native Spanish speaker, former Univision tech expert.

plugins.name: dealer-ga4-tracking-audit
plugins.description: Audit a car dealership's GA4 and Google Ads conversion tracking stack end-to-end. 10-dimension, 100-point framework covering GA4 property configuration, event taxonomy and key events, audiences, Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4-to-Ads conversion import, Enhanced Conversions, offline conversion import from CRM, cross-domain tracking, GTM container hygiene, and server-side tagging plus Consent Mode v2. Computes the reconciliation gap between GA4 reported conversions and CRM-confirmed leads as the headline deliverable. Dealer-specific failure patterns: Dealer.com/DealerOn/DealerInspire tag conflicts, third-party form vendors, Cars.com/AutoTrader attribution gaps, CallRail/Invoca sync, CUDL/RouteOne finance app cross-domain, CDK/Reynolds DMS-to-CRM-to-Ads pipeline.

plugins.name: dealer-call-tracking-audit
plugins.description: Audit a car dealership's call tracking platform configuration (CallRail, Invoca, Marchex) for attribution accuracy, conversation intelligence, and integration with Google Ads, GA4, and CRM. 10-dimension, 100-point framework covering platform deployment, number pool sizing, dynamic number insertion (DNI), source mapping and attribution, conversation intelligence (categorization, keyword spotting, scoring), Google Ads conversion sync, GA4 event sync, CRM integration, call routing and IVR, and recording/TCPA compliance. Computes the three-way reconciliation gap between platform totals, CRM phone-source leads, and Google Ads phone conversions. CallRail, Invoca, and Marchex platform-specific overlays.

plugins.name: dealer-ai-sentiment-monitor
plugins.description: Audit how AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, Claude, Copilot, optional Grok) describe and characterize a car dealership. 6-dimension, 100-point framework covering tone, factual accuracy, strength framing, concern framing, competitive positioning, and hallucination plus stale-data risk. 25-prompt English standard set plus 4-prompt Spanish set for bilingual markets, each run 3 times per engine for non-determinism. Per-engine score, cross-engine average, hallucinations table with severity classification, competitive framing remediation map, monitoring cadence. Distinct from dealer-customer-sentiment-analyzer (Google reviews) and dealer-ai-visibility (citation presence).

plugins.name: dealer-ai-referral-analytics
plugins.description: Audit a car dealership's AI-referrer traffic across GA4, Google Search Console, and server logs. 8-dimension, 100-point framework covering AI referrer detection in GA4 (custom channel group, custom dimension, audience), AI engine traffic volume and trend, landing page distribution, engagement quality vs organic, conversion and lead-to-sale ROI, GSC AI Mode and AI Overview presence detection via CTR drift, AI bot crawl traffic (GPTBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, Meta, Amazon, CCBot, others), and reporting cadence. Setup mode for dealers starting from scratch and Audit mode for current-state assessment.
